title: Search: Ctrl+K and the word Version finds the Engine version rows
covers: screen searchRows of the Engine page, Ctrl+K palette
context: The search palette (Ctrl+K) finds screens, settings rows, games, saved sessions and actions. The Engine page lists its rows for search, so typing Version finds Archipelago version and Python version, and Enter opens the Engine page at that row.
changed: search actions for sessions and runs

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Any state. The rows exist even with no engine.

steps: Press Ctrl+K. The search opens with a text box.
Type Version. The results include Archipelago version and Python version, each shown as a row of the Engine page.
Move to Archipelago version with the arrow keys and press Enter. The Engine page opens on the Versions section, with that row in view.
Press Ctrl+K and type python version. The result Python version shows. Press Enter: the Engine page opens at that row.
Press Ctrl+K and type downgrade. Both pickers (Archipelago version and Python version) show, found by their keywords.
Press Ctrl+K and type Change the engine. The row Change the engine shows. Type Installed engines instead: that row shows too.
Press Ctrl+K and type tour. The action Take the tour: Welcome to Archipelia shows. Press Escape. The search closes and nothing opens.
pass: Version finds the Archipelago version and Python version rows of the Engine page.
Enter opens the Engine page with the chosen row in view.
Keywords such as downgrade also find the rows, and Escape closes the search without changing the page.
fail: Version finds no Engine row, or only a screen and not its rows.
Enter opens the wrong page or a row that is not in view.
The search stays open after Escape, or opens something.
notes: More rows may match Version through their keywords (for example Change the engine or Installed engines). That is fine.
Say in your note how the result shows its place (for example the page name Engine), so the wording can be checked.
